name: CyberPulse-High-Severity-Incident-Template
description: Standardized Tier-1 / Tier-2 Incident Response Case Template following NIST SP 800-61 incident handling lifecycle (Identification, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, Lessons Learned).

tasks.title: 1. Identification & IoC Verification
tasks.description: Verify alert telemetry, extract source IP, process hash, parent lineage, and confirm VirusTotal/AbuseIPDB reputation scores.

tasks.title: 2. Verify Automated SOAR Containment
tasks.description: Confirm WinRM host network isolation filter active on target endpoint and verify pfSense firewall drop rule on perimeter gateway.

tasks.title: 3. Scope Lateral Movement & Credential Audit
tasks.description: Review Active Directory Kerberos TGT requests (EventID 4768) and check other endpoints in same VLAN for matching C2 hashes.

tasks.title: 4. Eradication & Malware Purge
tasks.description: Terminate persistence scheduled tasks, remove malicious payloads from \Windows\Temp\, and re-enable Windows Defender Real-Time Monitoring.

tasks.title: 5. Active Directory Account Reset & Recovery
tasks.description: Enforce mandatory password reset for affected domain user accounts and revoke all active OAuth/Azure AD refresh tokens.

tasks.title: 6. Post-Incident Review & Detection Tuning
tasks.description: Document root cause, update Detection Engineering Lifecycle (DELC) rule thresholds if necessary, and file final incident summary report.
